findings.fix: Add a lemma such as `Polynomial.eval_derivative_prod_X_sub_C : (∏ i, (X - C (a i))).derivative.eval z = ∑ i, ∏ j ∈ univ.erase i, (z - a j)` (with the matching `eval_prod_X_sub_C`) in `Algebra/Polynomial/BigOperators.lean`, and rewrite with it in both places.
findings.issue: The unfolding of `(∏ i, (X - C (a i))).derivative.eval z` into a sum of products uses the same long `simp only [derivative_prod_finset, derivative_sub, derivative_X, derivative_C, sub_zero, mul_one, eval_finsetSum, eval_prod, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C]` chain twice: in `exists_abs_linearCoeff_le` and in the `hcont` step of `tendsto_integral_reducedSource_sub_sq`. This is a reusable fact, and the chain will break when Mathlib renames any of those lemmas.

findings.fix: Close it in one step with `norm_num [Complex.finrank_real_complex]`, or state the inequality `(finrank ℝ ℂ : ℝ) < 4` explicitly.
findings.issue: In `tendsto_integral_reducedSource_sub_sq`, the side goal of `integrable_one_add_norm` is closed by a `simp [Complex.finrank_real_complex]` that does not finish the goal, followed by `norm_num`. What that `simp` leaves behind depends on the simp set, so this step is fragile.

findings.evidence: The same `simp only` appears at all of these sites in the diff.
findings.fix: Add `_top` versions on the unrestricted measure, for example `W1p.value_add_ae_top` and `W1p.integral_value_sq_eq_norm_value_sq_top` (`∫ z, value v z ^ 2 = ‖value v‖ ^ 2`), and use them at every one of these sites.
findings.issue: `simp only [TopologicalSpace.Opens.coe_top, Measure.restrict_univ]` is used again and again to strip the `⊤`-domain restriction. It appears after `W1p.value_add_ae`, after `W1p.integral_value_sq_eq_norm_value_sq` (in both `stability_le_mul_norm` and `norm_value_sub_sq_le`), in `inner_gradient_add_integral_reducedSource_mul_eq_zero`, and in `memLp_exp_two_mul_value_sub_one`. Each use hides the same fact about the whole-space versions of these lemmas.

summary: Proofs are mostly well structured, and both `change` uses carry a comment. Three spots need fixing: an 11-lemma `simp only` list is repeated, one `simp` is followed by `norm_num` and is fragile, and the same restriction-to-top rewrite is repeated where a lemma would serve.
